name: Dendritic Cell Sarcoma Not Otherwise Specified

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of spindle to ovoid tumor cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli arranged in fascicles or whorls
Expression of dendritic cell markers such as CD21, CD23, CD35, and absence of lineage-specific markers for lymphoid or myeloid cells
Exclusion of other spindle cell neoplasms and sarcomas by morphology and immunohistochemistry
Identification of localized or nodal mass by imaging studies

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with positive immunophenotyping for dendritic cell markers and exclusion of other neoplasms
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of morphology, immunophenotyping, and clinical correlation

pathognomonic.notes: Typically cervical or axillary lymph nodes
Commonly in lymph node regions or extranodal soft tissues
searchTerms: soft tissue growth in one area

common.symptomName: Constitutional B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)
common.notes: May be present in advanced disease

common.symptomName: Localized tenderness or discomfort at tumor site
searchTerms: pain or tenderness at tumor site

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory symptoms due to mediastinal involvement
searchTerms: respiratory symptoms due to mediastinal involvement
shortness of breath from chest area swelling

occasional.symptomName: Neurological deficits from central nervous system involvement
searchTerms: neurological problems from brain or spinal cord involvement
nerve function loss due to CNS disease
immune system attacks related to cancer

rare.symptomName: Bone marrow infiltration leading to cytopenias
searchTerms: bone marrow cancer causing low blood counts
blood cell deficiency from marrow disease

rare.symptomName: Renal impairment secondary to tumor infiltration

laboratory: Mild anemia or cytopenias in peripheral blood
Absence of lineage-specific markers for lymphoid or myeloid cells in immunophenotyping
imaging: CT or MRI showing localized nodal or extranodal masses
genetic: No consistent recurrent genetic mutations identified
Occasional chromosomal abnormalities reported in some cases
other: Histopathology demonstrating spindle to ovoid tumor cells with dendritic cell marker expression
Immunohistochemistry positive for CD21, CD23, CD35

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly follicular dendritic cell marker expression
Often localized to lymph nodes with less aggressive behavior
Expression of S100 and CD45 markers
Different immunophenotypic profile compared to NOS dendritic cell sarcoma
Lack of dendritic cell marker expression

references: Swerdlow SH, Campo E, Harris NL, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
Chan JK, Fletcher CD, Nayler SJ, Cooper K. Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma. A report of 17 cases. Am J Surg Pathol. 1997;21(6): 636-645.
Saygin C, Uzunaslan D, Ozguroglu M, et al. Dendritic cell sarcoma: a pooled analysis including 462 cases with presentation of an institutional experience. Crit Rev Oncol Hematol. 2013;88(2):253-271.
